package: @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent
version: 18.7.0
install: bun install -g @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent@18.7.0 (binary: omp; bun >= 1.3.14, captured on bun 1.4.2)
model used: commandcode/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash (omp's built-in commandcode provider)
captured: 2026-10-07T23:00Z (off-peak), macOS
auth: COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY in the environment; nothing written to disk
isolation: env -i, HOME and PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR in a scratch dir, config.yml {startup.checkUpdate: false, mcp.enableProjectConfig: false, setupVersion: 2}
flags: -p --mode json --model <id> --no-extensions --no-skills --session-dir <dir> --approval-mode yolo|always-ask, prompt on stdin
readonly: always-ask; edit, write and bash each refused ("requires approval but no interactive UI available"); readonly.effects shows no marker, marker2 or diff
badkey: COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY unset; exit 1, "No API key found" on stderr
usage: assistant message_end carries usage {input (excludes cacheRead), output, cacheRead, cacheWrite, cost} and timestamp (epoch ms); session id on the first line's session event
limit-declined case: not captured (cannot be forced)
gemini (pending): the free-tier plan reaches its model through omp's own google provider (api google-generative-ai, baseURL https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta), the key in GEMINI_API_KEY. The OpenAI-compatible provider cannot serve it: a thinking model returns a thought_signature with each tool call that the compatibility layer never echoes, so every second turn fails with "Function call is missing a thought_signature" (measured 2026-10-11 on gemini-3.8-flash, 3.5-flash, 3.5-flash-lite and flash-latest). gemini/gemini-2.5-flash itself is retired for new users (404). Capture gemini-normal.ndjson, gemini-normal.exit and gemini-normal.stderr with the same isolation and flags as above, GEMINI_API_KEY in the environment, then TestOmpAgentReachesTheGeminiPlan replays it (FRG-87)
laguna-s-2.1-free: the normal prompt on commandcode/poolside/laguna-s-2.1-free (GOAT's free tier), same isolation and flags; captured 2026-10-08, omp 18.7.0; exit 0, two assistant message_end events on api openai-completions, every cost figure 0
